menu-schema.description: Compact menu items contain only routing information. Full descriptions, prompts, and workflows are lazy-loaded.

item-schema.field: Reference to full definition (workflow path, action id, etc.)

example.yaml:
items: - cmd: "MH" label: "Menu Help" type: "display" tier: "standard"
- cmd: "SR" label: "Security Review" type: "workflow" tier: "full" ref: "workflows/security-review/workflow.yaml"

template.example:
[MH] Menu Help [CH] Chat [SR]* Security Review [ZT]* Zero-Trust Design [TM]* Threat Model [PM]* Party Mode [DA] Dismiss
(* = loads additional context)

1. [MH] Menu Help 2. [CH] Chat 3. [SR]* Security Review 4. [ZT]* Zero-Trust Design 5. [TM]* Threat Model 6. [PM]* Party Mode 7. [DA] Dismiss
(* = loads additional context)

--- Navigation --- [MH] Menu Help [DA] Dismiss
--- Operations --- [CH] Chat [SR]* Security Review [ZT]* Zero-Trust Design [TM]* Threat Model
--- Collaboration --- [PM]* Party Mode
(* = loads additional context)
Commands: MH | CH | SR* | ZT* | TM* | PM* | DA

standard-items.description: Items present in all agent menus

item.label: Menu Help
item.description: Redisplay the menu with all available options

handler.action: Display current menu using selected template

item.label: Chat
item.description: Open free-form conversation with the agent

item.label: Dismiss
item.description: Dismiss the current agent and return to framework

lazy-loading.description: Full item details are loaded only when the item is selected. This keeps initial menu display lean (~150 tokens).

on-item-selection.step: User selects item by number or command

IF item.tier == "full" AND current_tier == "standard": - Display: "Loading context for {label}..." - Trigger escalation to Tier 2 - Load item-specific content: - IF type == "workflow": Load workflow.yaml and instructions - IF type == "action": Load prompt/action definition - IF type == "conversation" (escalated): Load extended persona
Execute item handler with loaded context

legacy-extraction.description: Extract compact menu from legacy agent .md files during migration period.

source-format.example: <menu> <item cmd="SR or fuzzy match on security-review" exec="todo">[SR] Conduct comprehensive architecture security review</item> <item cmd="ZT or fuzzy match on zero-trust" action="Design or evaluate zero-trust architecture...">[ZT] Design zero-trust architecture</item> </menu>

extraction-rules.rule: cmd: Extract first 2-3 letter code before " or"
label: Extract text between brackets [X] and end of text
type: Determine from attributes (workflow, exec, action, etc.)
ref: Path from workflow/exec attribute if present

extraction-example.input: <item cmd="ZT or fuzzy match on zero-trust" action="Design or evaluate zero-trust architecture for given environment."> [ZT] Design zero-trust architecture </item>
extraction-example.output: cmd: "ZT" label: "Design zero-trust architecture" type: "action" tier: "full" ref: "#action-zt"

input-handling.description: How user input is matched to menu items. Supports multiple input methods for flexibility.

method.name: fuzzy
method.action: Substring match against cmd or label

no-match-response.template: Command not recognized: "{user_input}" Type [MH] to see available options.

token-budget.calculation: typical_menu = 7 items * 10 tokens + 20 formatting = 90 tokens max_menu = 15 items * 10 tokens + 30 formatting = 180 tokens

example-menu-file.content:
# Compact menu for Security Architect (Bastion) # ~100 tokens total
agent_id: security-architect display_template: default
items: # Standard tier (always available) - cmd: "MH" label: "Menu Help" type: "display"
- cmd: "CH" label: "Chat with Bastion" type: "conversation"
# Full tier (require escalation) - cmd: "SR" label: "Security Review" type: "workflow" tier: "full" ref: "workflows/security-review/workflow.yaml"
- cmd: "ZT" label: "Zero-Trust Design" type: "action" tier: "full" ref: "#zero-trust-action"
- cmd: "TM" label: "Threat Model" type: "action" tier: "full" ref: "#threat-model-action"
- cmd: "CS" label: "Cloud Security" type: "action" tier: "full" ref: "#cloud-security-action"
- cmd: "NS" label: "Network Segmentation" type: "action" tier: "full" ref: "#network-segmentation-action"
- cmd: "ID" label: "IAM Architecture" type: "action" tier: "full" ref: "#iam-action"
# Collaboration - cmd: "PM" label: "Party Mode" type: "workflow" tier: "full" ref: "src/core/workflows/party-mode/workflow.md"
# Exit - cmd: "DA" label: "Dismiss Agent" type: "exit"
# Rendered display (~90 tokens): # [MH] Menu Help # [CH] Chat with Bastion # [SR]* Security Review # [ZT]* Zero-Trust Design # [TM]* Threat Model # [CS]* Cloud Security # [NS]* Network Segmentation # [ID]* IAM Architecture # [PM]* Party Mode # [DA] Dismiss Agent # # (* = loads additional context)
